name: membership_grant_branches
description: Explicit branches covered by a BRANCHES-scoped grant; new branches never join silently.
lifecycle: Written with the grant; retained while the grant exists.

columns.Meaning: Company shared by the grant and the branch.
Grant whose scope includes the branch.

constraints.Physical definition: FOREIGN KEY (company_id, branch_id) REFERENCES branches(company_id, id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
constraints.Purpose: The branch belongs to the same company; mixed-company scopes are unrepresentable.

constraints.Physical definition: FOREIGN KEY (company_id) REFERENCES companies(id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
constraints.Purpose: The scope belongs to an existing company.

constraints.Physical definition: FOREIGN KEY (company_id, grant_id) REFERENCES membership_grants(company_id, id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
constraints.Purpose: The grant belongs to the same company.
A branch appears at most once in a grant's scope.

constraints.Physical definition: CREATE INDEX membership_grant_branches_branch_idx ON public.membership_grant_branches USING btree (company_id, branch_id)
constraints.Purpose: Supports finding the grants that cover a branch.
